title: Sup height of the support from a graph sup bound and a lower density bound
statement: Let n, l, U, V (weight μ, support spt V), q, f, c, A be as in tdo_graph_height_excess, with τ := q(graphPoint(0, c)), S := span{q(graphPoint(v, A v)) : v in R^n}, λ(x') := c + A x' and Γ := q '' graphOver f B̄^n_R(0), and let R, a, r, s₀, b, β, κ be real numbers with b >= 0, κ > 0, r + s₀ <= a and ||c|| + r + s₀ <= R. Assume: ||f(x') - λ(x')|| <= b for all x' in B̄^n_a(0); μ(B̄_R(0) ∩ (spt V \ Γ)) <= β; μ(B̄_s(x)) >= κ s for all x in spt V ∩ B̄_r(τ) and 0 < s <= s₀; and dist(x - τ, S) <= 2 s₀ for all x in spt V ∩ B̄_r(τ). Then dist(x - τ, S) <= max{2b, 2β/κ} for every x in spt V ∩ B̄_r(τ) (dist = infDist, closed balls).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (c : Rn ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (R a r s₀ b β κ : ℝ), 0 ≤ b → 0 < κ → r + s₀ ≤ a → ‖c‖ + r + s₀ ≤ R → (∀ x' ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) a, ‖f x' - (c + A x')‖ ≤ b) → V.weight (closedBall 0 R ∩ (V.support \ q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 R))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal β → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (κ * s) ≤ V.weight (closedBall x s)) → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, infDist (x - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ 2 * s₀) → ∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) r, infDist (x - q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) c)) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v))) : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ max (2 * b) (2 * β / κ)
